searchText: What are possible values for `excess_blob_gas`. Is this `[0, TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK]`? If you have blocks full of blobs for a long time, it accumulates without limit. (I guess the only indirect limit is price, which raises faster than excess blob gas)
